method: Thirty-nine bounded 500-row read-only pages compared the existing interaction's canonical fields with its retained Email source. The private source-field helper ran inside BEGIN READ ONLY and every transaction rolled back. No IDs or message content were returned.
limitation: The 19,061 source-equivalent rows are not yet adopted into the current projection-revision contract. A safe adoption must preserve the existing google-workspace connector provenance and hold the 67 non-equivalent or missing-source records for review. Counts are a snapshot, not permission to bulk rewrite canonical fields.
